one_liner: Cloud-based phone system and call center software with AI conversation intelligence and APIs.
auth_notes: Aircall supports both Basic Authentication (API ID and token) for private internal tools and OAuth for multi-user integrations.
access_notes: API access is tied to a customer account which can be started with a free trial, but continued use requires a paid plan.
api_notes: Covers calls, contacts, users, webhooks, and AI voice agent features via REST endpoints and webhooks.
blocker_notes: Public APIs and self-serve credentials are fully available.

verdict.quote: Extend your own setup, Connect your CRM, automate workflows, or build custom integrations for your own Aircall workspace, no marketplace approval needed.
